usd_reason: The upcoming Fed rates decision has put the USD in a wait-and-see mode
gold_reason: Easing Middle East tensions have reduced inflation risk and boosted gold prices
indices_reason: Lower oil prices and easing geopolitical tensions are supporting stock market gains
lead_story: The Federal Reserve's upcoming interest rate decision is the biggest macro driver right now, with markets watching for signs of a pause in rate hikes. The decision will be influenced by easing inflation pressures, including a sharp drop in oil prices. The Fed's communication strategy under new Chair Kevin Warsh is also being closely watched for clues on future policy direction
